title: Phase 3: Model Pricing Completeness — add 4 missing models to MODEL_PRICING
outcome: Added 4 missing model pricing entries (laguna-s-2.1, qwen/qwen3.6-27b-q4, qwen/qwen3.6-27b-lite, qwen/qwen3.5-9b) to MODEL_PRICING dict with 9 new tests. All 101 tests pass.
key_decisions: Pricing rates follow plan spec: laguna-s-2.1 at fallback rates, qwen3.6-27b-q4 matching base 27b, qwen3.6-27b-lite slightly lower, qwen3.5-9b lowest (size-proportional)
Added comparative tests (9b cheaper than 27b, q4 same as base) to catch future pricing inconsistencies
Tests added to existing test_model_pricing.py rather than a new file, following the established pattern
learnings: The plan's Phase 3 is straightforward data addition — no structural refactoring needed
MODEL_PRICING dict follows OCP naturally: extend by adding entries, no logic changes required
Vacuous test passes (guarded by 'if model_id in dict') can mask incomplete implementations — ensure tests fail before implementation
next_steps: Phase 4: Documentation and disclaimer — cache hit rate clarification and productive sessions estimation note
